newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan taxes 15 pct ahead of target to April.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan taxes 15 pct ahead of target to April.

text.p: Venezuelan tax collection over the first four months of the year was 15 percent ahead of target at 1.118 trillion bolivars ($2.3 billion), the National Taxation Superintendency SENIAT said Friday.
Tax collection in April alone was 37.9 percent up on expected levels at 318.269 billion bolivars ($663 million), the SENIAT figures showed.

SENIAT had set an annual tax goal of 3.5 trillion bolivars ($7.3 billion) for 1997 but has been asked by the government to squeeze out an additional 173 billion ($360 million), SENIAT head Moraima Campos told reporters.
